name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer messaging and support platform with a REST API for conversations, contacts and help center.
auth_notes: Private apps use an Access Token as Bearer; public apps must use OAuth.
access_notes: Private apps for your own paid workspace need no review. Public multi-customer apps must be reviewed and approved by Intercom. Free development workspaces exist.

buildability.rationale: Multi-customer integration is a public app needing OAuth and Intercom review; private token path needs a paid workspace.

identity.quote: Webhooks are a way that you can access real-time notifications about events that happen in your Intercom workspace.

auth.quote: Choose "Directly from the Intercom App Store" and provide the Direct installation url, which should be the link that will kick off the OAuth flow

access.quote: This means that the Intercom team must review and approve your app before it is available to install.
Private apps that only access your own paid workspace data do not require a review.

sandbox.quote: Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.

api_surface.quote: You can create a webhook subscription within your Intercom app by choosing the topics that you want to be notified about

mcp.quote: Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification

buildability.quote: you will need to submit it for a review from the Intercom team.

disputes.why: Public apps must be reviewed and approved by Intercom before install.
Getting-started page documents free development workspaces.
